guion hyphen. the hyphen is a linker of vowel word-stems to each other and prefixes. often an internal glottal stop and occassonally symbolizes an omitted letter. words ending -on,-an,-anan are not preceded by a glottal stop with very few exceptions such as ngay-an, sip-on & sud-an.
